factual_claims.claim: Finland-Sweden performance was affected by 68 days of vessel maintenance, while Estonia-Sweden revenue fell EUR 12.1 million and remained loss-making, although its result improved by EUR 1.4 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The routes’ results were impacted by maintenance works on the cruise ferries Silja Serenade and Baltic Princess that totalled 68 days in the first quarter of 2025.' and 'Year-on-year, the revenue of the Estonia-Sweden routes decreased by EUR 12.1 million to EUR 85.3 million. The segment result improved by EUR 1.4 million to a loss of EUR 1.2 million.'

factual_claims.claim: Costs were mixed.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report details varying cost changes: personnel expenses increased, fuel costs stable, depreciation decreased, etc.

factual_claims.claim: Personnel expenses increased 4.3% to EUR 201.0 million, mainly due to the collective agreement covering maritime workers, while fuel and emission costs were broadly stable at EUR 96.5 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Total personnel expenses amounted to EUR 201.0 million (EUR 192.8 million in FY24). [...] Personnel expenses related to servicing and technical personnel amounted to EUR 150.2 million compared to EUR 142.8 million in FY24.' and 'Fuel and emission costs for the financial year 2025 amounted to EUR 96.5 million (EUR 95.8 million in the financial year 2024).'

factual_claims.claim: Depreciation and amortisation fell EUR 18.0 million to EUR 79.8 million, primarily because useful lives of most cruise and passenger vessels were extended to 45 years and three vessels were sold.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Amortisation and depreciation expense decreased by EUR 18.0 million to EUR 79.8 million year-on-year. Depreciation expense decreased mainly due to the alignment of the estimated useful lives of the cruise and passenger vessels (except for shuttle vessels) to 45 years, resulting in lower depreciation rates. The decline in depreciation expense was further impacted by the sale of three vessels in the financial year 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: This change reduced 2025 depreciation by EUR 16.7 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 14: 'The Group aligned the useful lives of its cruise and passenger vessels (except for shuttle vessels). [...] The total effect of the change was EUR 16,684 thousand less depreciation expense in 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: Net finance costs also declined EUR 6.8 million to EUR 21.4 million as debt balances and interest rates decreased.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'As a result of a decreased outstanding loan balance and declining interest rates, net finance costs declined by EUR 6.8 million year-on-year to EUR 21.4 million in the financial year 2025 (EUR 28.3 million in the financial year 2024).'

factual_claims.claim: The Group sold Star I, Regal Star and Sailor, reducing its fleet to 11 vessels and eliminating vessel lay-ups by the third quarter.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'During the financial year, the Group completed the sale of three vessels. The passenger vessel Star I was sold [...] in April, the cargo vessel Regal Star [...] in August and the cargo vessel Sailor [...] in October.' and 'The number of vessels in lay-up decreased from four at the end of the first quarter of 2025 to zero by the end of the third quarter of 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: Debt reduction continued: interest-bearing liabilities fell 19.9% to EUR 445.9 million and net debt to EUR 432.4 million, although net debt to EBITDA increased to 3.3 from 3.1 because EBITDA declined.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'As at 31 December 2025, the Group’s net debt amounted to EUR 432.4 million compared to EUR 537.7 million as at 31 December 2024. The net debt to EBITDA ratio stood at 3.3 as at 31 December 2025 (3.1 as at 31 December 2024).' and 'At the end of the financial year 2025, interest-bearing liabilities totalled EUR 445.9 million, down by 19.9% compared to EUR 556.4 million at the end of the financial year 2024.'

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow remained positive at EUR 127.1 million, while investing cash flow benefited from EUR 78.8 million of vessel-sale proceeds.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Liquidity and Cash Flow: 'The Group’s net operating cash flow for the financial year 2025 was positive at EUR 127.1 million (EUR 153.4 million in the financial year 2024).' and 'Net cash flow from investing activities was EUR 46.1 million (EUR 3.2 million in the financial year 2024), including proceeds from disposals of EUR 78.8 million.'

factual_claims.claim: After EUR 44.6 million of dividends, related tax, and EUR 113.5 million of loan and interest payments, year-end liquidity increased to EUR 110.4 million through higher unused credit facilities.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Liquidity and Cash Flow: 'The Group’s cash position was impacted by the payment of dividends in the amount of EUR 44.6 million and related income tax of EUR 11.3 million.' and 'At 31 December 2025, the Group’s cash and cash equivalents totalled EUR 13.5 million (EUR 18.7 million at 31 December 2024). In addition, available unused overdraft credit lines amounted to EUR 96.9 million (EUR 75.0 million in 2024). The total liquidity buffer [...] amounted to EUR 110.4 million at 31 December 2025 (EUR 93.7 million at 31 December 2024).'

factual_claims.claim: The Group will propose another EUR 0.06-per-share dividend for 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Dividends: 'In agreement with the Supervisory Board of the Group, the Management Board of the Group will propose to the General Meeting of Shareholders that a dividend of EUR 0.06 per share be paid in 2026.'
